# Vercel: retrieve the feature flags of a deployment

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To retrieve feature flags for a Vercel deployment, call the Vercel REST API at SOURCE FACT REQUIRED endpoint with SOURCE FACT REQUIRED authentication header. The response returns SOURCE FACT REQUIRED return shape containing SOURCE FACT REQUIRED fields for flag name, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED status code, and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED callback configuration. Agents must provide SOURCE FACT REQUIRED configuration details for SOURCE FACT REQUIRED environment variables.
